name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new tool or capability
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## What capability are you looking for?

A clear description of the Selenium/WebDriver or CDP capability you'd like exposed as an MCP tool, or the enhancement to an existing tool.

## Use case

What are you trying to accomplish? Why can't an existing tool (or combination of tools) do this today?

## Proposed tool surface (optional)

If you have a rough idea of the tool name, parameters, and return value, sketch it here — see [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md) for the conventions new tools should follow (e.g. `@McpTool` methods always return strings).

## Alternatives considered

Any workarounds you're currently using, or other approaches you considered.

## Additional context

Anything else relevant — links to the underlying Selenium/CDP API, etc.
